summaries.en: Open official browser links in the Desktop workbench, keep subagent model and permission controls usable, and restore Side Chat opens plus queued-message actions.
summaries.zh: Desktop 工作台内打开官方浏览器链接，修复子代理模型与权限控件，并恢复 Side Chat 打开与排队消息操作。
